notes: #1: Rijksmuseum dates it 1566, the year of Hoefnagel’s drawing (inscribed on the plate); the plate was published in vol. 5 (1598), so 1598 is used. #23 is El Greco’s View of Toledo (about 1599–1600, Metropolitan Museum), misdated 2015 by the photo date; it would also fit P1 if a painting is preferred over the engraving. #7: Rijksmuseum dates it 1694; the trilingual caption suggests Pieter van den Berge’s Theatrum Hispaniae, but the maker isn’t named in the record, so left as unknown. #17: Rijksmuseum gives only about 1850–63 (Clifford’s years in Spain); ‘about 1857’ is the middle of that range. #20: the Alcázar is still a ruin from the 1936 siege. #6 is the vol. 1 plate (1572) shared with Valladolid, a fine alternative to #1. #2’s identity is unclear (single Toledo plate with a big sky, possibly a later copy). Rejected: #15, #16 are Via Toledo in Naples; #19 is Toledo, Ohio; #13 and #14 are a cathedral interior and facade; #8 has only a 1700–99 date.
